title: Sunrise Over the Horizon
poem: The sun climbs high, its golden light shines wide,
What you set your heart on will be satisfied.
meaning: Your luck is at its peak. Old obstacles will clear, and what you have been waiting for will happen soon.

advice.love: Singles may meet the right person. Couples grow closer. Go ahead and share your feelings.
advice.study: You will pass your exams with ease. Your memory is sharp, so it is a great time to start learning something new.
advice.work: Your seniors notice your work. A promotion or an important assignment may come your way.
advice.money: Money flows well, with income from several sources. Remember to save part of it.

title: A Seedling in the Rain
poem: The seedling drinks the rain and slowly starts to grow,
Be patient, and one day it will give you shade below.
meaning: What you are doing is going well. The results are not clear yet, but steady effort will lead to success.

advice.love: Love grows step by step. Care about the small things, and the other person will notice.
advice.study: Review a little every day. Your exam results will be better than you expect.
advice.work: The work you put in will start to pay off. Don't give up or change your mind halfway.
advice.money: Your income is stable. It is a good time to start saving or make a long-term plan.

title: The Dragon Takes Flight
poem: The dragon rides the clouds, the wind lifts it high,
A helping hand will guide you, and your path is wide.
meaning: Someone powerful is ready to support you. Big plans will go well, so set clear goals.

advice.love: A friend or an elder may help bring you together with someone. Love is moving in a good direction.
advice.study: A teacher or senior student will guide you. Ask questions and you will understand much faster.
advice.work: Your boss supports you. It is a good time to propose a new project.
advice.money: Good luck from a deal or a good offer. Think carefully and you will make a profit.

title: A Boat Against the Waves
poem: A little boat rows on through wind and wave,
Don't lose heart, the shore is near, be brave.
meaning: Some obstacles are coming, but if you stay calm and don't give up, you will get through them.

advice.love: There may be a small misunderstanding. Talk openly and calmly.
advice.study: Some subjects are harder than you thought. Plan your study time and don't leave it to the last night.
advice.work: Work may get stuck. Have a backup plan and don't promise more than you can do.
advice.money: You are spending more than usual. Stop buying things you don't need for a while.

title: The Lotus Above the Water
poem: The lotus rises from the pond, so bright and clean,
Do good today, and soon its rewards will be seen.
meaning: The good things you have done are starting to pay off. People trust you, and your mind feels calm and happy.

advice.love: Your honesty is your charm. The other person likes you for who you are.
advice.study: Your focus is strong. It is a good time for reading or detailed reports.
advice.work: Your coworkers trust you, and teamwork goes smoothly.
advice.money: You have just enough. You may receive a gift or kindness from someone you know.

title: The Golden Swan Returns Home
poem: The golden swan flies home to a warm and cozy nest,
What was lost returns, and old friends come as guests.
meaning: Something you lost or drifted away from will come back. Old relationships will be restored.

advice.love: Someone you drifted apart from may reach out again. Couples will spend more time together.
advice.study: Things you didn't understand will become clear. Go back and review the basics.
advice.work: A job or chance you missed may come back. Be ready for it.
advice.money: Money you lent may be returned, or payment you were owed will arrive.

title: Clouds Cover the Moon
poem: Dark clouds hide the moon, the road is hard to see,
Wait for the sky to clear, then walk on carefully.
meaning: This is not a good time to make big decisions. Wait and watch the situation first.

advice.love: Be careful with words that can hurt. Don't make love decisions when you are upset.
advice.study: Watch out for careless mistakes. Check your answers and write down your deadlines.
advice.work: Be careful of miscommunication. Keep important things in writing.
advice.money: Don't invest or lend money right now. Keep some savings for emergencies.

title: Gold in the Sand
poem: You dig the sand and find a piece of gold,
Your hard work brings good fortune, rich and bold.
meaning: Your past efforts will be rewarded beyond what you expect. Good luck and good news are coming.

advice.love: Love is bright. Singles may unexpectedly meet someone who is a great match.
advice.study: Better grades than expected, or a scholarship, prize, or praise from a teacher.
advice.work: Your work stands out and gets noticed. Good offers will come in.
advice.money: Unexpected luck or extra income. Spend it wisely and it will grow.

title: A Cool Morning Breeze
poem: A cool breeze blows at dawn, your heart feels light,
The bad days pass away, and good ones come in sight.
meaning: Your worries will slowly fade. Life is entering a calm time, with small joys all around you.

advice.love: Love feels warm. It is a good time to plan a trip or do something together.
advice.study: Study in the morning and you will remember more. Relax while learning and it will be easier.
advice.work: Work moves forward smoothly with nothing to worry about.
advice.money: Your money is steady, with no big expenses to worry about.

title: The Galloping Horse
poem: The horse runs fast across the open plain,
Act quickly and boldly, and victory you'll gain.
meaning: It is a good time to take action. Courage and speed will bring you success.

advice.love: If you have a crush on someone, now is the time to start. Don't wait too long.
advice.study: A good time to apply for exams, join a competition, or start a big project.
advice.work: Grab the chances that come. A new job or a job change looks good.
advice.money: Hard work brings more income. A side job can earn you good money.

title: Rain That Doesn't Fall Everywhere
poem: The rain falls here and there, some fields stay dry,
Don't lose your strength, a new season will come by.
meaning: Results may not be as good as you hoped. Some things succeed and some must wait. Stay calm and adjust your plan.

advice.love: Don't expect too much from the other person. Give love in a balanced way.
advice.study: Some subjects go well, others need more work. Try studying with a friend.
advice.work: Some work needs fixing. Don't feel down. Treat it as a lesson.
advice.money: Income is uncertain. Keeping track of what you earn and spend will help a lot.

title: Flowers by the Roadside
poem: Flowers bloom along the road with a sweet perfume,
Smile at everyone, and new friends will soon bloom.
meaning: Friends and the people around you bring good luck. Being open to new people will create good chances.

advice.love: You may meet someone you like through friends or at a party.
advice.study: Group study helps a lot. Share what you know with your friends.
advice.work: Your network helps you succeed. Don't hesitate to ask for help.
advice.money: A friend's tip may help you earn more, but check it carefully first.

title: A Path with Thorns
poem: There are thorns along this path, so step with care,
Go slowly and stay calm, and no harm will meet you there.
meaning: There are hidden obstacles. Don't rush. Check every detail before you decide.

advice.love: Be careful of people with sweet words. Take time to get to know them first.
advice.study: Don't take wrong shortcuts like copying work. It may hurt you later.
advice.work: Be careful about signing or agreeing to anything without reading it closely.
advice.money: Watch out for scams and offers that sound too good to be true.

title: A Candle in the Cave
poem: Light a candle in a dark cave, and its glow will spread,
Wisdom is your light, it leads you through the dark ahead.
meaning: Problems that seemed hopeless will be solved with clear thinking. Your creativity shines.

advice.love: You understand each other more deeply. Talking about the future goes well.
advice.study: Ideas flow easily. Great for research, reports, or creative work.
advice.work: You will solve the problem your team is stuck on. Your work will be recognized.
advice.money: You are good at finding new ways to earn. Try turning your skills into income.

title: The Full Moon
poem: The full moon lights up all the sky so bright,
Your wishes all come true, everything turns out right.
meaning: Everything is complete. Love, work, and money are all good at the same time. This is a happy time.

advice.love: Your love wishes come true. Couples may have good news about an engagement or wedding.
advice.study: You reach your goals and get into the place you hoped for.
advice.work: Your work finishes beautifully, and you receive praise and rewards.
advice.money: You are well off, with money to save and to share with others.

title: A Small Bird Builds Its Nest
poem: The small bird builds a nest just right in size,
Build slowly, piece by piece, and it will stand for life.
meaning: Know what is enough and plan well. Your life will be stable. There is no need to rush beyond your strength.

advice.love: A simple but steady love. Value the person beside you.
advice.study: Set goals you can really reach, then raise them little by little.
advice.work: Work steadily according to plan. Your results will be solid and trusted.
advice.money: A good time to save and pay off debts. Your finances will become more stable.

title: Leaves Change Color
poem: The leaves change color as the seasons turn,
Let go of the old, there are new ways to learn.
meaning: You are entering a time of change. You may feel unsure, but adapting will bring good things.

advice.love: Your relationship is changing. Talk openly about what each of you wants.
advice.study: You may need to change how you study. Find the method that fits you.
advice.work: There may be restructuring or a job change. See it as a chance to learn.
advice.money: Your expenses may change with the situation. Review your spending plan.

title: The Golden Bell Rings
poem: The golden bell rings out, good news is on its way,
Your name will travel far, and people will praise you every day.
meaning: Good news and recognition are coming. Many people will learn about your work.

advice.love: Someone secretly admires you. Be open and you will hear good news.
advice.study: You may win praise or a prize in a competition, and get a chance to present your work.
advice.work: Many people recognize your work. A great time to present in front of a big audience.
advice.money: Good income comes from your reputation and trust.

title: The Gentle River
poem: The river flows gently, it never stops or tires,
Keep moving without fear, and you'll reach the sea you desire.
meaning: Being steady is the key. You don't need to rush, but don't stop, and you will reach your goal.

advice.love: Love goes smoothly. Caring for each other regularly will bring you closer.
advice.study: Reading a little every day is better than cramming all at once.
advice.work: Work moves forward little by little. Be patient and the results will be good.
advice.money: Save a little at a time and you will see the results in the long run.

title: A Storm Is Coming
poem: A storm is gathering, thunder rolls through the sky,
Take shelter, don't push on, wait for the wind to die.
meaning: Trouble or conflict may be ahead. Step back, get your balance, and take good care of yourself.

advice.love: Don't turn small issues into big ones. Give each other time to calm down.
advice.study: Don't overwork and hurt your health. Rest well and you will study better.
advice.work: Watch out for conflict at work. Stay neutral and stay out of gossip.
advice.money: Watch out for emergency costs. Check your insurance and savings.

title: The Golden Bodhi Tree
poem: The golden Bodhi tree spreads its branches wide and cool,
Your good deeds bring you peace, and happiness will rule.
meaning: Your past good deeds support you, and your life is peaceful and happy. Others can rely on you, and good things will come back to you.

advice.love: Your love is as strong as a big tree. Family and partner fully support each other.
advice.study: You are so good that friends rely on you. Teaching others will make you even better.
advice.work: You may get a chance to lead. Your team trusts you and is ready to follow.
advice.money: Wealth is stable and growing. A good time for long-term planning.

title: A New Door Opens
poem: A new door opens wide and light comes shining in,
Be brave and step ahead, new chances will begin.
meaning: New opportunities are coming. It may be a new place, a new person, or something new worth trying.

advice.love: Singles may meet someone new in an unfamiliar place.
advice.study: Try a new subject or skill you are curious about. You may discover your talent.
advice.work: A new job or project is waiting. Don't say no just because it is unfamiliar.
advice.money: A new way to earn money appears. Learn about it first and it will go well.

title: The Swimming Goldfish
poem: The goldfish swims in clear water by the lotus bloom,
Plenty fills your life, good fortune fills the room.
meaning: Plenty is coming your way. You will have all you need, and things will flow as easily as a fish in water.

advice.love: Love flows naturally. You feel relaxed and happy together.
advice.study: You learn quickly and have fun. Great for learning a language or a new skill.
advice.work: Work runs smoothly. Clients and coworkers cooperate well.
advice.money: Business is good, and money keeps flowing in.

title: A Lamp Running Low
poem: The lamp is running low, its light begins to fade,
Refill your strength first, then light the path you've made.
meaning: You may be too tired. Rest and recharge first, then keep going.

advice.love: Give yourself some time. Good love starts with caring for your own heart.
advice.study: Don't stay up all night studying. Enough rest helps you remember more.
advice.work: Too much work. Set priorities and say no to what isn't necessary.
advice.money: Be careful about spending money to relieve stress. Try free activities instead.

title: The Wooden Bridge
poem: A wooden bridge across the stream, a hand to help you through,
True friends are always near, ready to help you too.
meaning: There is always someone ready to help you. Your problems will be solved by working together.

advice.love: The person beside you supports you. Remember to thank them and take care of them too.
advice.study: If you get stuck, ask a friend or teacher. You will understand faster.
advice.work: Teamwork between groups will help the job succeed.
advice.money: If money is tight, someone will help, but make a clear plan to pay them back.

title: The North Star Guides You
poem: The North Star shines to guide you on a dark and stormy sea,
Keep your heart steady, and you'll reach where you want to be.
meaning: You know what you want. Clear goals will lead you to success.

advice.love: You know your own heart. Honest love will lead to a good relationship.
advice.study: Set clear study goals and you will stay motivated all the way.
advice.work: A good time to plan your long-term career. You have chosen the right direction.
advice.money: Set a clear savings goal and you will reach it sooner than you think.

title: Bamboo Bends in the Wind
poem: The bamboo bends with the wind, it does not break or fall,
Be gentle yet be strong, and you will pass it all.
meaning: Be flexible right now. Give in on small things, and you will keep what really matters.

advice.love: Give a little on both sides, and your love will last a long time.
advice.study: You may not love every subject, but each one will be useful someday.
advice.work: Listen to different opinions. Adapt to your team and the work will move forward.
advice.money: You can get by. Don't take risks on investments you don't understand.

title: A Blessing from Heaven
poem: Heaven sends a blessing, joy in every direction,
Whatever you set out to do will reach perfection.
meaning: One of the best fortunes. What you hope for is likely to succeed. Keep doing good and share your happiness with others.

advice.love: All your wishes come true. Your love is full of understanding and happiness.
advice.study: You finish your studies as you hoped, or get into the school of your dreams.
advice.work: Great success. You are respected both inside and outside your organization.
advice.money: Lots of good luck. Your income is stable and keeps growing.
